summary: Forest-department cottages on the Purna river deep inside Purna sanctuary — the base for dawn walks, river mornings and real forest nights.
description:
Mahal is the night you remember from a Dang trip: a forest-department campsite on the banks of the Purna river, deep inside the sanctuary, where the generator quiets, the canopy closes over the cottages and the forest runs the soundtrack. Accommodation is eco-campsite standard — riverside cottages and tents, simple mess meals when booked — and the location is the entire luxury.

Stays unlock what day permits can't: dawn guided walks when the forest is loudest, the river in first light, night skies with zero competition, and the internal roads before day visitors arrive. The historic Mahal forest rest house nearby dates to colonial forestry days, and the campsite continues that tradition of foresters' hospitality in plainer form.

Book through the forest department's eco-tourism channels well ahead for winter weekends. Combine a night here with Girmal Falls and the Shabari Dham circuit and interior Dang stops feeling remote and starts feeling organised.
highlights: Dawn guided walks from your doorstep
history_legend: Mahal has been a forestry station since the colonial teak-working era — the old rest house predates the sanctuary and hosted generations of forest officers.

modes.road: Via the Mahal forest road from Ahwa or the Waghai side; sanctuary check-post entry
modes.rail: Waghai narrow gauge; Bilimora Jn for broad gauge

access.last_mile: Drive-in to the campsite; riverbank paths on foot
access.road_condition: Tarred approach, forest-track final stretch; slow after rain

timings.note: Day visits within sanctuary hours; guests per booking

fees.note: Sanctuary permit applies for the drive in; campsite tariffs separate via booking

booking.notes: Stays via the forest department's eco-tourism portal/range office; winter weekends fill weeks ahead

visit.notes: Monsoon operation is limited when sanctuary access tightens — check while planning.

seasonality.notes: October–March is the dependable season; early monsoon can suspend access entirely.

experience.photography_notes: River mist at dawn is the frame; astro works from the riverbank on moonless winter nights.

amenities.food: Campsite mess with booking; nothing else within 30 km — carry supplements
amenities.guides: Campsite staff arrange guided walks — take the dawn slot

warnings: No wandering beyond campsite bounds after dark — leopard country
River bathing only at the spots staff indicate, in lean flow
Carry cash; nothing digital works reliably here

emergency.police: Ahwa PS; Mahal range office on site

tips: Book the dawn walk when you book the cottage — slots are few
Pair the stay with Girmal Falls (25 km) the next morning
Pack a power bank and torch; supply is generator-scheduled

faqs.q: Is Mahal suitable for a family with kids?
faqs.a: Yes for kids who enjoy outdoors — the campsite is safe and staffed. It is not for those needing hotel comforts; power, food and network are all forest-basic.
